header.goal: The aim is not to win but to avoid being the Bhabhi. Players who empty their hand drop out; the last one still holding cards is the Bhabhi.
header.led: Led: {{suit}} ({{n}} on the table -- fail to follow and you take them all)
header.noLead: The table is empty. Lead whatever you like.

settings.playerCntHelp: Three to seven. Changing it deals a fresh game for that many.

result.stalemate: Deadlocked after {{tricks}} tricks. {{name}} holds the most cards and is the Bhabhi.

hint.bhabhiLead: Lead from the suit you hold most of.
hint.bhabhiDuck: You can follow. Play low and let it go.
hint.bhabhiDumpHigh: You cannot follow, so you take the pile anyway -- dump a high card.

tutorial.goal: Bhabhi names **a loser, not a winner**. Players who empty their hand drop out one by one, and **whoever is still holding cards at the end is the Bhabhi**. There is no prize for getting out early.
tutorial.pile: **Fail to follow the led suit and every card on the table goes into your hand.** The size of the pile is the size of the penalty. Only a trick everyone followed leaves play for good.
tutorial.out: **The player who picks up does not lead next.** Letting them lead would send the same card back and forth between two hands forever. Each seat shows how many times it has picked up.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Playable cards get a green ring. When you cannot follow you are **taking the pile regardless**, so throw the high card you least want to be stuck with.
